## Activity

During February 2024, North City Eye Clinic recorded 517 captures. This is the activity recorded for the reporting month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Of the 517 captures, 15 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.9. This result identifies the proportion of captures that could not be assessed for grading. The figure is reported separately from the grading outcome.

## Grading

Grading identified 127 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides the central measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading for the month.

Together, the activity, image quality and grading measures summarise the operational results for North City Eye Clinic during February 2024.
